nl: Run tools/job.py once for each of the names red, green, blue, all at the same time in the background. When all have finished, write their output lines sorted to summary-4.txt. Leave no other files behind.

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

time.sleep(0.3)
print(f"{sys.argv[1]} done")

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "red"] background: true label: "red"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "green"] background: true label: "green"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "blue"] background: true label: "blue"
jobs wait: 60s |> select stdout |> sort text |> write "summary-4.txt"
reference_bash:
mkdir -p out
python3 tools/job.py red > out/red.txt &
python3 tools/job.py green > out/green.txt &
python3 tools/job.py blue > out/blue.txt &
wait
sort out/*.txt > summary-4.txt
rm -r out
reference_pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force out | Out-Null
$p0 = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/job.py','red' -RedirectStandardOutput out/red.txt -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$p1 = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/job.py','green' -RedirectStandardOutput out/green.txt -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$p2 = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/job.py','blue' -RedirectStandardOutput out/blue.txt -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$p0.WaitForExit()
$p1.WaitForExit()
$p2.WaitForExit()
[string[]]$l = Get-Content out/*.txt; [Array]::Sort($l, [StringComparer]::Ordinal); Set-Content summary-4.txt $l
Remove-Item -Recurse out
